verdict.rationale: The pack confirms that Datadog documents an AI assistant (Bits AI) alongside its Incident Management, Monitors and Watchdog features, which suggests AI help is available in incident workflows. However, these items are page titles only, and none says that Bits AI generates incident summaries or alert context for responders. missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI-generated incident summaries, AI-generated alert/monitor context for responders, details of how summaries reach responders, independent or hands-on corroboration.
